sheet_layout.capture_sha_definition: sha256 of capture_replay.mkv bytes (the media identity); per-frame stills bound by frame_files (tick -> sha256)
rows: top band: diagnostic viewports [overview | side | close-up] with the five declared diagnostic layers
bottom band: clean viewports, no overlay
sheet_layout.tick_to_seconds_map: 1 tick = 1/300 s simulated; frames are the 60 decision-boundary ticks 14..899 (pinned EVENT_STRIDE 15) at 10 video fps; the video is the FFV1 lossless encode of the rendered stills
